text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown trains for the Tokyo Sports 
Hai Junior Stakes. She devises a strategy 
based on the race's characteristics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond watches over the scene. She 
vowed that once she reached her prime, she 
would surpass Satono Crown... and Kitasan 
Black as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the day of the race finally arrived. 
Satono Crown pumped herself up and stepped 
out onto the track—!
